model_selection_rule: Highest complete-validation average precision; exact ties: ROC-AUC, then detector name.
selection_rule: Among validation thresholds with recall >= 0.60 choose highest F2; ties minimize false positives, then maximize threshold. If none qualifies, highest F2 with the same tie rules. F2 penalizes excessive false positives; no external alert-budget standard is claimed.
extreme_rule: Maximum of validation score 99.9th percentile and next representable score above selected threshold; no TEST scores used.
